title: The Greatest Commandment

questions.question: What did Moses command Israel to love God with?
options: All their heart, soul, and might
questions.correctAnswer: All their heart, soul, and might
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:5 (ESV): "You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might."

questions.question: Where were God’s words to be kept?
options: On their hearts and taught to children
questions.correctAnswer: On their hearts and taught to children
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:6–7 (ESV): "And these words... shall be on your heart. You shall teach them diligently to your children..."

questions.question: What were the Israelites to bind as a sign on their hands?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:8 (ESV): "You shall bind them as a sign on your hand..."

questions.question: What did Moses warn against when they prospered?
options: Forgetting the Lord who brought them out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Forgetting the Lord who brought them out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:12 (ESV): "then take care lest you forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt..."

questions.question: What did Moses say not to test, as at Massah?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:16 (ESV): "You shall not put the LORD your God to the test, as you tested him at Massah."

questions.question: What statement begins the Shema?
options: "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."
questions.correctAnswer: "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:4 (ESV): "Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."

questions.question: When should you talk of these commandments?
options: When sitting, walking, lying down, and rising
questions.correctAnswer: When sitting, walking, lying down, and rising
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:7 (ESV): "...talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise."

questions.question: Where should the commandments be written on the house?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:9 (ESV): "You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates."

questions.question: What kind of cities would they inhabit?
options: Great and good cities that they did not build
questions.correctAnswer: Great and good cities that they did not build
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:10 (ESV): "...to give you great and good cities that you did not build..."

questions.question: Why should they fear and serve the Lord only?
options: For the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God
questions.correctAnswer: For the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:15 (ESV): "for the Lord your God in your midst is a jealous God..."

questions.question: What should a son be told when he asks about the statutes?
options: "We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt. and the Lord brought us out with a mighty hand"
questions.correctAnswer: "We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt. and the Lord brought us out with a mighty hand"
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:21 (ESV): "Then you shall say to your son, 'We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt...'"

questions.question: What is it to us if we are careful to do all this commandment?
options: It will be righteousness for us
questions.correctAnswer: It will be righteousness for us
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:25 (ESV): "And it will be righteousness for us, if we are careful to do all this commandment..."

questions.question: How did God show signs and wonders in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:22 (ESV): "And the Lord showed signs and wonders, great and grievous, against Egypt..."

questions.question: By what did the people of Israel swear?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:13 (ESV): "...and by his name you shall swear."

questions.question: What is the danger of going after other gods?
options: The anger of the Lord would be kindled and destroy you
questions.correctAnswer: The anger of the Lord would be kindled and destroy you
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:15 (ESV): "...lest the anger of the Lord your God be kindled against you and he destroy you from off the face of the earth."

key_verse_text: “Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one. You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.” (ESV)
